THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.title: The King's Servant
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.INITI:
A cloaked figure steps from the shadows, blocking your path. He bows deeply — a servant of the [purple]King[/purple].

[sine][gold]"I have been sent to find those who have proven themselves."[/gold][/sine]

He produces an [gold]envelope[/gold] of pale pink, sealed with the King's sigil.

[sine][gold]"An invitation to the King's chambers. Accept it, and you will be summoned when the time comes."[/gold][/sine]
Gain [green]{MaxHp}[/green] Max HP. [red]Downgrade[/red] a random card.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.ACCEP:
You take the envelope. It is warm to the touch, as though the King's will pulses within it.

The servant nods.

[sine][gold]"When you reach the heart of the Spire, the King will be waiting. Do not lose it."[/gold][/sine]

He bows once more and vanishes into the shadows.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.OFFER:
You draw a blade across your palm. [jitter][red]Blood[/red][/jitter] drips onto the stone floor.

The servant watches without expression. As the pain subsides, clarity washes over you — a technique you once struggled with now feels [b]effortless[/b].

[sine][gold]"The King accepts your offering."[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.DECLI:
You lower your gaze. The servant's eyes soften briefly.

[sine][gold]"Your humility grants you mercy. But what you have not earned, I shall take back."[/gold][/sine]

A [green][jitter]jolt of vitality[/jitter][/green] courses through you as a [purple]technique you once mastered[/purple] slips from your grasp. The servant is gone.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.title: The King's Throne Room
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.I:
You stand at the threshold of a vast throne room. Pillars of [b]obsidian[/b] rise toward a ceiling lost in shadow.

At its far end, upon a throne of [sine][gold]black iron[/gold][/sine], sits the King — ageless, silent, [jitter]watching[/jitter].

His gaze falls upon you like a weight. He speaks without moving his lips.

[sine][gold]"Few stand where you stand. State your purpose."[/gold][/sine]
Present [gold]King's Invitation[/gold]. Enter the King's chambers.
[blue]10%[/blue] chance to enter. Otherwise, lose [red]10[/red] Max HP.
You accepted the King's invitation. You must enter.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.E:
The invitation dissolves in your hand as you step forward. The King regards you from his throne.

[sine][gold]"You have answered my call. Now — what would you ask of the King?"[/gold][/sine]
Obtain [gold]Mardan Fu Mardan's Ring[/gold]. Gain [gold]King's Curse[/gold].
Remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random cards. Choose a [gold]Rare[/gold] card from any character.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.C:
The King [jitter][b]rises[/b][/jitter]. The room [jitter][red]trembles[/red][/jitter].

[sine][gold]"You have earned this."[/gold][/sine]

He extends a hand — and a [gold]ring[/gold] of [purple]ancient[/purple] make materializes upon your finger. But as the ring settles, a [red]cold ache[/red] spreads through your chest.

The King sits.
[sine][gold]"Power has its price. You know this."[/gold][/sine]

The King [jitter][b]rises[/b][/jitter]. The room [jitter][red]trembles[/red][/jitter].

[sine][gold]"So it is you. The one who would claim dominion."[/gold][/sine]

He extends a hand — and [orange]invisible fire[/orange] courses through you. A ring of [purple]terrible power[/purple] appears on your finger, but your vision darkens as your very [jitter][red]life force[/red][/jitter] drains away.

[sine][gold]"Dominion demands everything. You know this."[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.B:
You kneel. The King watches, [purple]unmoved[/purple].

[sine][gold]"Gold is the simplest desire. So be it."[/gold][/sine]

A [jitter][gold]cascade of coins[/gold][/jitter] spills from the darkness behind the throne. As you gather them, a [gold]glint[/gold] catches your eye — something else tumbles from the shadows.

[sine][gold]"The King rewards those who kneel."[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.A:
[sine][gold]"Power demands sacrifice,"[/gold][/sine] the King intones.

Cards lift from your deck unbidden, dissolving into [purple]motes of light[/purple]. In their place, knowledge of a [gold]rare and potent technique[/gold] settles into your mind.

[sine][gold]"Use it wisely. There will be no second gift."[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.E:
You step forward and perform — a tale, a trick, a display of skill.

The King's eyes flicker with the faintest spark of interest. He raises a single finger.

[sine][gold]"...Amusing. You may lighten your burden."[/gold][/sine]

With a gesture, he allows you to discard what no longer serves you.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.P:
You approach the threshold empty-handed and speak your case. The King listens, unmoving. Then, almost imperceptibly, he gestures you forward.

[sine][gold]"An uninvited guest. Speak, while I am in a listening mood."[/gold][/sine]

You approach the threshold empty-handed. The King does not speak — but you [jitter][red]feel[/red][/jitter] his displeasure.

An unseen force [jitter]crushes[/jitter] down upon you. Your body weakens, your vision blurs. When it passes, you stand outside the throne room, gasping.

[sine][gold]You were not invited.[/gold][/sine]
